metric.label: QB composite
metric.tip: Gridiron QB composite: EPA per dropback, CPOE, sack avoidance and turnover-worthy plays, each stabilisation-shrunk, on a 100 = average, 10 = one SD scale (our qb model; a blend of the same components when it is not available).

metric.label: Gridiron Value

metric.label: Splash EPA
metric.tip: EPA prevented on plays the player made (sack, interception, forced fumble, pass defensed, tackle for loss), shared among the credited players. Individual defensive value is limited by the data.
